verdict.rationale: Google Cloud documents fine-grained IAM controls over who can do what on which resource. It also documents Workload Identity Federation, which gives workloads federated identities instead of long-lived service account keys. Together these are first-party building blocks for narrowly scoped workload credentials, but nothing in the evidence frames them as agent-specific patterns. missing for 10: documented agent-specific credential patterns, explicit short-lived/temporary token issuance, documented guarantees against privilege escalation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
